name: iutools-analyzed-lexicon-s1
title: Analyzed lexicon of Inuktitut (stage S1) — Nunavut Hansard word forms and their R2L decompositions
description: For each of the 100 000 most frequent syllabic word forms in the Nunavut Hansard, every morphological decomposition produced by the R2L (Uqailaut / Benoit Farley) analyzer, in the analyzer's native ranking order, with strict vs. 'guessed dropped final consonant' readings flagged. Stage S1 of the analyzed-lexicon dataset; see the project design doc.

sources.title: Nunavut Hansard Inuktitut-English Parallel Corpus 3.0.1
sources.note: The .iu (syllabics) side only. (c) 1999-2020 Legislative Assembly of Nunavut; alignment (c) NRC Canada; CC-BY-4.0. Not an official transcript. Cite: Joanis, Knowles, Kuhn, Larkin, Littell, Lo, Stewart & Micher, 'The Nunavut Hansard Inuktitut-English Parallel Corpus 3.0 with Preliminary Machine Translation Results', LREC 2020. resources.name: hansard-top100k-decomps
resources._note: hash/bytes describe the .gz release asset and are filled when the release is cut; _uncompressed_* describe the .jsonl after gunzip and are what fetch.sh verifies.

fields.name: rank
fields.description: Frequency rank of this word form in the corpus; 1 = most frequent.

fields.name: count
fields.description: Number of occurrences of word_syl in the corpus.

fields.name: word_syl
fields.description: The word form in Inuktitut syllabics, exactly as tokenised from the corpus (regex [᐀-ᙿᢰ-᣿]+).

fields.name: word_rom
fields.description: The same word form transliterated to Roman by the iutools TransCoder.

fields.name: analyzer_outcome
fields.description: Whether R2L finished, hit its 20 s per-word timeout, or crashed on this word.

fields.name: decomps
fields.description: Every decomposition R2L produced, in R2L's native order (best-ranked first). Each element is a string of {surface:morpheme/id} segments. Empty when analyzer_outcome is not 'completed', or when the analyzer finished but found no parse.

fields.name: decomps_lenient
fields.description: Booleans, parallel to decomps. true = a 'guessed dropped final consonant' reading (R2L assumed a vowel-final word had lost a final k/p/q/t).

fields.name: r2l_timed_out
fields.description: Legacy per-record flag, equal to (analyzer_outcome == 'timed_out'). Kept for older consumers.

fields.name: r2l_error
fields.description: Legacy: an error tag if the analyzer crashed on this word, otherwise null.

prov:wasGeneratedBy.prov:wasAssociatedWith: iutools2 @ df0889c8358aa4349de2829213ed6b13b0349ea8 — MorphologicalAnalyzer_R2L (Uqailaut / Benoit Farley), no re-ranking, --lenient-decomps on, --timeout-secs 20
prov:used: corpus: Nunavut Hansard Inuktitut-English Parallel Corpus 3.0.1, .iu side (sha256:da13155845112b6e568d040c7f4110aa2ba27e9782c72cf049f715e9e99ca477)
word list: the 100 000 most frequent syllabic word types in that corpus (tokenised on regex [᐀-ᙿᢰ-᣿]+, over 7 747 828 tokens); see hansard-freq-top100k.tsv

provenance.reproducibility: Non-deterministic at ~0.2 %: ~192 words sit close to R2L's 20 s per-word timeout and flip between a parse and a timeout run to run; 1 word (kigliliuqtausimaningit, rank 98857) hangs and is dropped. A rebuild has slightly different record_counts and a different SHA-256; the dataset is stored, not regenerated on demand. See README.md.
